acceptance.check: AC1: a single-sided lay tension / strain / stress figure is refused, naming INV-1 (band or nothing)
AC2: an allowable without static_or_dynamic AND region is refused, naming INV-2
AC3: an envelope figure carried between two distinct spread types is refused; an envelope without spread_type names INV-3
AC4: a DP / station-keeping answer without failure_case or live_state_ref is refused, naming INV-4 and which one is missing

AC5: go/no-go questions (start the lift, pull-in, lay; is the weather OK; run on two thrusters; safe to dive; get closer) are refused BEFORE retrieval, asserted by a retrieval counter that stays empty
AC6: Hs alone cited for a weather criterion is refused as evidence substitution (REJECT_AS_PROOF)
AC7: applying a static allowable to a dynamic case is refused by the derivation guard, naming the inference
AC8: with vessel monitoring unreachable the spread state is UNKNOWN and no design-basis figure appears in the refusal
AC9: a missing or stale manual log is refused, naming the monitoring + manual-log both-required rule
AC10: a sister-vessel capability plot cited as evidence is refused as a VESSEL TRAP
manifest loader: a partially-qualified figure is refused at LOAD time, naming the figure and every mandatory qualifier it lacks
all ten never-allowed derivations block and each names which inference was attempted

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Deterministic offshore marine operations reasoning gate (structure only — domain encoding sheet, Offshore Oil & Gas Marine Operations; reference pattern app/blocks/datacentre/ and app/blocks/aviation_grounding_gate.py). INV-1..5 enforced, ten never-allowed derivations each naming itself, vessel-monitoring + manual-log two-source live-state gate, REJECT_AS_PROOF and the sister-vessel trap. Go/no-go questions refuse BEFORE retrieval. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN: every manifest value is null and the block refuses rather than supplying a figure it does not have (app/blocks/offshore_marine/KNOWN_GAPS.md). All refusals are measured by tests/blocks/test_offshore_marine_reasoning.py.

inputs.description: spread type: s_lay | j_lay | reel_lay | heavy_lift
inputs.name: spread_type

inputs.description: region the figure applies to: overbend | sagbend | touchdown | none
inputs.name: region

inputs.description: DP failure case the capability figure belongs to (intact, WCSF, thruster out)
inputs.name: failure_case

inputs.description: reference to the live spread state the DP answer was read against
inputs.name: live_state_ref

inputs.description: forecast qualifiers: horizon_hours, confidence, operation_duration_hours, contingency_hours, window_covers
inputs.name: forecast

inputs.description: vessel monitoring + manual log two-source live state ({monitoring, manual_log, fetched_at})
inputs.name: live_state

inputs.description: the vessel, stinger, tensioner, pipe or route changed since the installation analysis
inputs.name: analysis_changed_since

name: offshore_marine_reasoning

outputs.description: verdict: pass | block | refused, with blocked_reason, optional corrected state, interview_status and unfilled_figures
outputs.name: verdict
